note: Rebuilt 25 September 2026 from the audited FY2025 report of the issuer, Group column. Every row is a printed figure. The identity Assets = Liabilities + Equity holds in all five years, as do Non-current plus Current Assets = Total Assets and Non-current plus Current Liabilities = Total Liabilities. The five-year summary prints no cash and equivalents line, so that row is blank for FY2023 to FY2021.
